 17 New Beauty Launches Of October To Add To Your Skincare And Makeup Wishlist
 Sakshi Singh | 26.OCT.2026 Link copied to clipboard 
 Our beauty wishlists are officially getting longer, and the latest launches are giving us plenty of reasons to make room on our shelves. From skincare that focuses on keeping your skin barrier happy to lip products in every finish imaginable, this edit has something for every kind of beauty lover. Think lightweight sunscreens for Indian weather, glossy lip oils, fuss-free makeup kits and even gift sets that make festive shopping a little easier. Here are 17 new beauty launches of October worth checking out.
 1) Skinvest: Daily Zen Toner
 If your skin swings between oily one day and dehydrated the next, Skinvest’s Daily Zen Toner is designed to respond to both. Its water-based formula combines Sebocytine, Aquaxyl, Sodium PCA and Hydrovance™ to help regulate sebum while maintaining hydration. A 2% PHA and lactic acid complex offers gentle exfoliation, while centella, mugwort, ginseng, galactomyces and birch sap support a calmer-looking complexion. Made with India’s heat and humidity in mind, it’s a daily toner that aims to balance rather than strip your skin.
 2) Daylybody: Hot Stuff Protection Body Sunscreen
 Applying sunscreen to your body shouldn’t feel like an additional workout, and Daylybody’s Hot Stuff Protection aims to make the process easier. The body sunscreen has a lightweight mousse texture that glides over the skin and absorbs quickly, offering broad-spectrum SPF 50 PA+++ protection. It’s designed to avoid the sticky, greasy feeling and chalky residue that can make body sunscreens less appealing. For anyone who wants sun protection without spending ages rubbing in a thick formula, this one sounds like a convenient everyday option.
 3) The Solved Skin: Spot Fade Advanced Repair Serum
 Post-acne marks can hang around long after a breakout has packed its bags. The Solved Skin’s Spot Fade Advanced Repair Serum combines solubilised azelaic acid with niacinamide to target the appearance of pigmentation and redness. Ceramides, panthenol and allantoin are included to help soothe irritated skin and support its barrier. The formula is designed to address existing dark spots while helping reduce the likelihood of future breakouts. If uneven tone is your current skincare concern, this serum is worth looking into.
 4) Nykaa Cosmetics: Lovestruck Velvet Matte Lipstick
 For those who love a matte lip but hate the dry, uncomfortable feeling that sometimes comes with it, Nykaa Cosmetics’ Lovestruck Velvet Matte Lipstick collection offers a more comfort-focused option. The range features 12 shades, spanning everyday nudes to bolder colours, with rich pigment designed to show up in a single swipe. Collagen-boosting peptides are included to help keep lips hydrated, while the formula aims for a flexible feel rather than a stiff finish. The sleek silver packaging, complete with a signature heart cutout, adds a cute finishing touch.
 5) ASAYA: Glow Forward Radiance Serum
 Dullness and dark spots are the focus of ASAYA’s Glow Forward Radiance Serum, a lightweight formula designed to support brighter-looking, more even-toned skin. It features stabilised EGCG, an antioxidant, alongside the MelaMe Complex, which targets different processes involved in pigmentation. Encapsulated vitamin C adds another brightening component through a controlled-release formula intended to help minimise irritation. The brand cites clinical results for improved radiance and visible dark-spot reduction within 14 days. As with any brightening product, consistent use and daily sunscreen remain important.
 6) Chosen: Safescreen Sheer Sunscreen
 Oily and acne-prone skin types know the struggle of finding sunscreen that doesn’t leave them feeling slick by lunchtime. Chosen’s Safescreen Sheer is a lightweight gel-crème sunscreen developed for oily, combination and acne-prone skin, with testing in hot and humid conditions. Its Interface Flow Technology is designed to help the formula spread evenly and settle quickly without a white cast. The brand says it can keep skin feeling cool for over three hours and oil-free for more than four hours in heat and humidity. It also offers water-resistant protection.
 7) Mesai: Persian Oud Mini Ritual Gift Box
 A gift that smells lovely and is actually useful? Mesai’s Persian Oud Mini Ritual Gift Box brings together three everyday essentials in a coordinated fragrance. The set includes a 100 ml body milk, a 100 ml shampoo and a 100 ml shower gel, all centred around Persian Oud. The scent blends oud with rose, jasmine, lily and lavender for a floral profile with a refined feel. Packaged in Mesai’s signature green octagonal box, it’s an option for birthdays, bridal celebrations, anniversaries or festive gifting.
 8) e.l.f. Cosmetics: Glow Reviver Lip Oil Glimmer
 Gloss lovers, this one’s for you. e.l.f. Cosmetics’ Glow Reviver Lip Oil Glimmer takes the brand’s familiar lip-oil format and adds a sparkling, high-shine finish with a sheer wash of colour. Its oversized cushion applicator is designed to make application quick and easy, while the nourishing formula helps lips feel comfortable. A fresh minty scent adds to the experience, and the non-sticky texture makes it easy to wear on its own or layer over lipstick. It’s a simple way to add a little shimmer without committing to a full glitter look.
 9) Praush Beauty: Glassfix Lip Gloss Stain With Vegan PDRN
 Can’t decide between a glossy lip and a long-lasting stain? Praush Beauty’s Glassfix combines the two in an oil-and-water hybrid formula that the brand describes as a first for India. With 33% water-based freshness, squalane and vegan PDRN, it is designed to deliver a glass-like shine without a heavy or sticky feel. The formula also aims to leave lips looking smoother and plumper. Rich Girl Energy is the standout shade for me, settling into a pretty brown-pink colour that works for everyday wear.
 10) Praush Beauty: Cushion Blur Matte Mousse Lipstick
 On the other end of the lip-finish spectrum is Praush Beauty’s Cushion Blur Matte Mousse Lipstick. The soft mousse texture glides onto lips and can be built up from a subtle tint to a more dramatic colour payoff. Its soft-focus finish is designed to blur the appearance of lip lines instead of highlighting them, while the lightweight formula aims to avoid that tight, dry feeling associated with some matte lipsticks. It’s a good concept for anyone who loves a diffused, velvety lip without wanting a thick layer of product.
 11) Type Beauty: Glitter Jelly Tint In Champagne And Rosé
 A little shimmer can take festive makeup from everyday to celebration-ready in seconds. Type Beauty has expanded its Glitter Jelly Tint range with Champagne and Rosé, two new shades designed for bridal looks, parties and festive dressing. Champagne offers a soft, luminous shimmer, while Rosé brings a pink-toned glow. The multi-purpose tint can be applied to the eyes, cheeks, lips and collarbones, making it a handy option for creating a coordinated look without reaching for multiple products. Think subtle sparkle or a more noticeable glow, depending on your mood.

 12) Glam21: Party Ready Glam Makeup Kit
 If getting ready for a party involves digging through five different makeup bags, Glam21’s Party Ready Glam Makeup Kit offers a more streamlined alternative. The set includes a non-transfer crayon lipstick, Velvet Touch Oil Control Silk Foundation, Forever Matte Compact, Floral Hues nine-in-one eyeshadow palette, HD Dense Mascara and HD Dense Eyeliner. The products are designed to cover the basics, from complexion and shine control to defined eyes and a bold lip. With a travel-friendly format and shades intended for Indian skin tones, it’s a practical all-in-one option for festive events and weddings.
 13) Ashpveda: Trinity Gift Box
 For the person who prefers a considered skincare routine over a shelf full of products, Ashpveda’s Trinity Gift Box brings three steps together in one set. It contains Kannauj Rose Water Face Mist (100 ml), Kashmiri Saffron and Neem Face Wash (100 ml), and Nourishing and Restoring Night Cream (30 g). Saffron, neem, rose and sandalwood give the collection its botanical focus, with cleansing, toning and overnight care forming the core of the routine. It’s a thoughtful gifting pick for someone who enjoys simple rituals and traditional Ayurvedic-inspired ingredients.
 14) Recode Studios: Spray Serum And Silky Moisturiser Combo
 Recode Studios’ hydrating duo pairs a refreshing spray serum with a silky moisturiser for a routine that moves from hydration to makeup prep. The 100 ml Hydrating Spray Serum features hyaluronic acid, vitamin E and plant-based oils, and is designed to hydrate without a heavy feel. The accompanying 60 g Silky Moisturiser doubles as a moisturiser and primer, helping soften skin and create a smoother base for makeup. Together, the products are intended to support hydration and radiance through the day. It’s a convenient pairing for anyone who likes a few easy steps before applying makeup.
 15) Eltior: Lip Plush Balm
 Eltior is stepping into lip care with Lip Plush Balm, a four-flavour treatment range built around butters, ceramides and hyaluronic acid. The formula is designed to keep lips hydrated, smooth and comfortable, with each variant bringing its own scent, flavour and tint. Very Berry is the juicy berry-red option, adding a hint of colour while keeping the focus on moisture. It’s a handy middle ground for days when you want something more colourful than a clear balm but don’t feel like wearing a full lipstick.
 16) BieBeauty: B-TOX
 BieBeauty’s B-TOX focuses on skin firmness and the appearance of fine lines, using a blend of eight advanced peptides, including copper peptides. The formula is designed to support skin elasticity and leave the complexion looking smoother and more resilient with consistent use. It is also positioned as a treatment for skin that looks tired or sun-stressed. While skincare can’t replace professional treatments or promise instant lifting, peptide-focused formulas can be an interesting addition to a routine centred on hydration and the appearance of ageing.
 17) Traya: Defence Shampoo And Conditioner
 Haircare gets a two-step update with Traya’s Defence Shampoo and Conditioner combo. The shampoo is designed to cleanse the scalp, while the conditioner helps restore moisture and leave hair softer and easier to manage. The range focuses on reducing dryness, frizz and breakage, with scalp health forming part of its approach to stronger-looking hair. Traya also notes that hair loss can have different underlying causes and that this pair alone is not a complete hair-loss solution. The brand recommends a broader treatment plan where needed, rather than relying on shampoo and conditioner alone.
